response.sql:
WITH pair_counts AS (
  SELECT tr.transreg, trd.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS behavior_count
  FROM advancedbehavior AS ab
  JOIN transactionrecord AS tr
    ON ab.translink = tr.transreg
  JOIN trader AS trd
    ON tr.trdref = trd.tradereg
  GROUP BY tr.transreg, trd.tradekind
),
shares AS (
  SELECT transreg, tradekind, behavior_count,
         behavior_count::numeric / SUM(behavior_count) OVER () AS count_share
  FROM pair_counts
)
SELECT tradekind,
       AVG(behavior_count) AS average_count_per_pair,
       AVG(count_share) AS average_share_per_pair
FROM shares
GROUP BY tradekind;

assumptions.assumption: Each pair is a transaction and its trader type, as specified; the share denominator is the total behavior-record count across all matched pairs. Averages are over the pairs present for each trader type.
